title: 第十二章 同袍贼影，人心寒雪
slug: 穿越戍边我从炮灰辅卒一路封王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陈石头的喊声穿透风雪，瞬间压下戍堡内所有动静。

正在收拾残械、烘烤马肉的十几名残兵，动作齐刷刷停住，所有人瞬间抬头，脸色尽数一变。

羯族骑兵他们不怕。

外敌明刀明枪，杀来杀去，好歹光明正大。

可穿着大雍军甲、鬼鬼祟祟躲在后山雪林窥探的人，才最让人头皮发寒。

周疤子手里的烤肉条直接掉在雪地里，猛地攥紧腰间残刀，咬牙低喝：“看错没有？真是咱们自己的兵？”

“绝对没错！”

陈石头跑得气喘吁吁，脸色惨白，连连点头。

“甲胄样式、胸口兵徽，都是雁朔关正规守军的制式！一共两个人，躲在林子边缘树后，一直盯着山洞方向偷看！”

“我一动，他们立刻缩身后退，借着雪雾往远处溜了！”

这话落地，全场死寂。

冰冷的寒意，比北疆的风雪更刺骨，直直钻进所有人心里。

在场都是守边多年的老兵，瞬间就品出了不对劲。

黑石戍堡地处最北荒无人烟之地，远离关内驻军防区。

正常情况下，正规守军根本不会跑到这种鸟不拉屎的雪原深处。

更何况，还是偷偷摸摸窥探，见人就跑。

刘屯将脸色彻底沉了下去，眉头死死皱着，声音发哑：“不对劲，太不对劲了。”

“镇北军方才全线回撤布防，关内守军本该驻守隘口，严防异族渗透。”

“怎么会有两个正规兵，单独摸到我们后山？还专门盯着我们藏伤员的山洞？”

没人答得上来。

但所有人心里，都冒出一个冰冷的猜测。

之前苏烬推断的那件事，大概率是真的。

掏空戍堡物资、层层克扣粮饷的上层，不止贪财。

他们早就在暗中勾结外人，连戍堡的布防、人手、伤员藏点，都时刻盯着。

这群人，比羯狗更阴毒。

羯王攻城，是要你的命。

可这些披着同袍战甲的自己人，是背地里挖坑、断你活路、卖你军情，眼睁睁看着你战死冻死。

苏烬眼神冷了下来。

他刚刚拼尽全力，救活必死重伤兄弟、稳住涣散人心、布置好进退活路。

明守戍堡，暗藏后山，本以为总算有三天喘息的时间。

结果转头，自家后方，就被人悄悄盯上了。

“对于整个雁朔关来说，他们不过是隐藏在暗地里的蛀虫，见不得光我们还有无数和我们一起保家卫国的兄弟。

既然他们盯上咱们了，那就找机会把这群臭虫碾死！”

苏烬压下心底冷意，语速极稳，快速下令。

“周疤子，带五个人，持利刃弓箭，沿雪林边缘低调探查。”

“别追深，别露头厮杀，只摸清楚对方落脚点、有没有大股人马埋伏。”

“一旦发现不对劲，立刻回撤，不许逞强。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Chen Shitou's shout penetrated the wind and snow, instantly suppressing all movement in the fort.

The dozen or so remnant soldiers who were packing up their remaining weapons and roasting horse meat suddenly stopped. Everyone looked up instantly and their expressions changed.

They are not afraid of the Jie cavalry.

Foreign enemies use their swords and guns to kill, but they are fair and square.

But the people wearing Dayong armor and sneaking around in the snow forest behind the mountain to spy are the most chilling people.

The barbecue strips in Zhou Scarzi's hand fell directly to the snow, and he suddenly tightened the remaining knife in his waist, gritted his teeth and shouted: "Did you read that wrong? Are they really our own soldiers?"

"Absolutely right!"

Chen Shitou was panting from running, his face was pale, and he nodded repeatedly.

"The armor style and the chest emblem are all the standard of the regular defenders of Yanshuoguan! There are two people hiding behind the trees on the edge of the forest, staring in the direction of the cave and peeking!"

"As soon as I moved, they immediately retreated and slipped away through the snow and fog!"

As soon as these words fell to the ground, the whole place was completely silent.

The icy chill was more biting than the wind and snow in northern Xinjiang, and it penetrated into everyone's heart.

There were all veterans who had been guarding the border for many years, and they immediately knew something was wrong.

Blackstone Fort is located in the northernmost desolate and uninhabited area, far away from the garrison area within the pass.

Under normal circumstances, the regular defenders would never go to the depths of this inhospitable snowfield.

What's more, he still snoops secretly and runs away when he sees someone.

Liu Tun's face darkened completely, his brows were furrowed, and his voice became hoarse: "Something's wrong, something's so wrong."

"The Zhenbei Army has just withdrawn and deployed its defenses across the board. The garrison inside the pass should have been stationed at the pass to prevent alien infiltration."

"How come there are two regular soldiers who reached the mountain behind us alone? And they are specifically looking at the cave where we hide the wounded?"

No one can answer.

But there was a cold suspicion in everyone's mind.

What Su Jin deduced before was most likely true.

The upper echelons who emptied the fort of supplies and deducted food and wages at every level were not only greedy for money.

They have been secretly colluding with outsiders for a long time, and they are always keeping an eye on the fort's defenses, manpower, and hiding places for the wounded.

This group of people is more sinister than a Jie dog.

King Jie is attacking the city to kill you.

But these fellow soldiers, who are wearing the same armor, are digging holes behind your back, cutting off your livelihood, selling out your military connections, and watching you die in battle and freeze to death.

Su Jin's eyes turned cold.

He had just tried his best to save his dead and seriously injured brothers, stabilize the people's hearts, and arrange a way forward and retreat.

Guarding the fort openly and hiding in the back mountains, I thought I would finally have three days to breathe.

As a result, when he turned around, he was quietly stared at from behind his house.

"For the entire Yanshuoguan, they are just moths hiding in the dark. We have countless brothers who work with us to defend our country.

Since they are targeting us, let's find an opportunity to crush these bugs to death!"

Su Jin suppressed the coldness in his heart, spoke at a very steady pace, and gave orders quickly.

"Zhou Scarzi, lead five men, armed with sharp bows and arrows, to conduct a low-key exploration along the edge of the snow forest."

"Don't chase deep, don't show your head and fight, just find out where the opponent is and whether there is a large group of people ambushing him."

"Once you find something is wrong, retreat immediately and don't show off."
